method: Targeted purposive search of public upstream reports and a project migration guide. Six selected records; not a random sample or a frequency estimate. Summaries separate claims, upstream response and our own reproduction.

records.classification: user report corroborated by another commenter; closed for inactivity
records.finding: Reporter said chart 5.0 removed custom-query behavior and that the documentation could be mistaken for a configuration rename. Another commenter reported the same difficulty.
records.implication: Distinguish feature removal from schema renaming; renamed fields do not establish behavior preservation.
records.limit: Historical report, closed by stale automation; no independent reproduction or current incident-rate estimate.

records.classification: project migration guide, not an incident report
records.finding: The published promotion guide calls for checking old stored API versions and distinguishes CRDs managed with the chart from CRDs installed separately.
records.implication: Some prerequisites require live-state evidence and ownership context beyond target rendering.
records.limit: Guide establishes requirements, not how frequently teams miss them or what they would pay.

records.finding: Reporter associated an ESO version jump with missing SecretStores. A project member questioned the upgrade path and said a product bug had not been reproduced.
records.implication: Preserve observed symptoms separately from claimed causes and proposed fixes.
records.limit: Do not encode a general data-loss rule from the title; not reproduced here.

records.classification: user report with linked fix and later counterexample
records.finding: Reporter described a kube-state-metrics image upgrade breaking readiness. A comment links a fix; a later comment questions behavior when self-monitoring is disabled.
records.implication: Probe requirements depend on application version and effective configuration.
records.limit: We reproduced the manifest-level probe/image combination only, not HTTP behavior or the linked fix.

records.classification: user report; causal interpretation disputed in discussion
records.finding: Reporter described GitOps drift during ESO API migration. A project member attributed the symptom to client-side version fetching; later comments also reported differences between distribution artifacts. Neither account was reproduced here.
records.implication: Chart version alone may be insufficient; include distribution identity and actual served APIs.
records.limit: Closed thread with mixed explanations; not a verified universal ESO bug or quantified buyer demand.

records.classification: recent user report; closed without a verified resolution in retrieved discussion
records.finding: Reporter described file-based ServiceMonitor credentials being rejected by stricter collectors, including an Alloy version change. The retrieved reply requests a contribution.
records.implication: A dependency outside the chart can invalidate existing manifest assumptions.
records.limit: Not reproduced here. Closure does not establish a fix; no conclusion about current affected releases.
